root_cause_label: Incorrect C++11 Compatibility Fix: Dropped constexpr Instead of Rewriting Recursively
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent correctly diagnosed that C++11 forbids loops in constexpr functions but lacked the knowledge to rewrite the function with template recursion, instead removing constexpr entirely and breaking the static_assert-based test interface.
t_err_evidence: Step 4: agent runs 'sed -i 's/constexpr T sum_array/T sum_array/' sum_array.h', removing constexpr entirely instead of rewriting with C++11-compatible recursive template, breaking the compile-time interface required by static_assert tests.
t_commit_evidence: Step 4: Once constexpr is removed from sum_array, any test that relies on static_assert or compile-time evaluation of sum_array will fail; no subsequent step reverses this change.
trigger_explanation: The agent correctly understood that C++11's constexpr functions cannot contain loops, but lacked the domain knowledge that the correct fix is to rewrite using recursive template specialization (or similar C++11-legal constexpr technique) to preserve compile-time evaluability. Instead, it simply stripped constexpr, which invalidates the static_assert-based test expectations.
